sentences.text: Mcrc No. 8949 of 2023

Diptesh Choube S/o Shri Satish Choube Aged About 25 Years R/o
Village- Kevra, Tahsil- Pratappur, District : Surajpur, Chhattisgarh
 ---- Applicant
 Versus
State Of Chhattisgarh Through The Station House Officer, Police Of
Police Station- Pratappur, District : Surajpur, Chhattisgarh

---- Respondent
For Applicant : Mr. Kishore Narayan, Advocate For State : Mr. Ankur Kahsyap, Dy. Govt. Advocate
S.B.: Hon'ble Shri Parth Prateem Sahu, Judge Order On Board 17/01/2024
1.

Applicant has filed this application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail as he has
been arrested in connection with Crime No.250/2023 registered at Police Station -Pratappur,
District- Surajpur (Cg) for the offence punishable under Sections 366, 376 (2) (n), 294, 506, 323, 34
of Ipc.
2.
Case of the prosecution, in brief, is that on 26.09.2023, victim lodged report stating that at the time of going to college, applicant took her to nearby hotel, abused her and also assaulted her.
He further contented that on 22 nd September 2022, she met with the applicant and they became friend.
Thereafter, the applicant on the pretext of marriage, committed forceful sexual intercourse with her first time on 17th October 2022 and thereafter on many occasions.
Lately the applicant established physical relations with the victim on 10.09.2023.
Based on the report, aforementioned crime was registered and the applicant was arrested on 28.11.2023.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the crime.
Victim is a major girl.
Even if the allegation of establishing physical relation is accepted, it appears that the victim is consensual party and therefore with ulterior motive, aforementioned allegation was levelled.
He has not committed any offence.
There is no other criminal antecedent of the applicant.
He is in jail since 28.11.2023, therefore, the applicant may be released on bail.

4. Learned counsel for the State opposes the submission of learned counsel for the applicant and would submit that victim had made specific allegation against the applicant of establishing sexual intercourse with her in the month of September 2022.
However, upon asking, learned counsel for the State submits that there is no criminal antecedent of the applicant in the case diary.

sentences.text: 5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties.

6. Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case, nature of allegation, period of relationship, age of the victim, without commenting anything on merits of the case, I am inclined to allow the bail application.
7.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on regular bail on his furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one local surety in the like sum to the satisfaction of the Court on the conditions that:-
a) Applicant shall appear before the trial Court regularly on each and every date,
unless exempted from appearance.
b) Applicant shall not, in any manner, tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
Certified copy as per rules.
